usedFor: Doubletick messages go through your Doubletick account with “Send WhatsApp Message”, and “Add Tag to a Customer” sorts people.

bestTemplate.name: “Add Tag to a Customer” in Doubletick
bestTemplate.why: It tags an existing customer, so chats can be sorted without sending anything.

watchOut: “Delete a group” removes a group by group ID, so check the ID first.
